name: diazepam
warning: Increased sensitivity and risk of cognitive impairment, delirium, falls and fractures in older adults.

name: diphenhydramine
warning: Strong anticholinergic properties — confusion, dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention.

name: nitrofurantoin
warning: Risk of pulmonary toxicity and reduced efficacy with low creatinine clearance.
recommendation: Avoid for long-term suppression in older adults with low CrCl.

name: meperidine
warning: High risk of CNS excitation and neurotoxicity (normeperidine).
